notes.title: Major update 3.0 - Infliction: Extended Cut
notes.content:
This has been a long time coming. I’m happy to announce Infliction update 3.0, Infliction: Extended Cut. This is a large update with several fundamental changes to the game to make it more optimised and provide a smoother player experience. In addition to optimisations and bug fixes, there is additional content and New Game Plus! Many of you know, Infliction: Extended Cut made its way to PS4, XboxOne and Nintendo Switch earlier this year thanks to the help and support of the talented team at Blowfish Studios. This update brings those additions and changes to the PC version.

Also, this update introduces Traditional Chinese as a new language.

Without further ado, Infliction update 3.0 contains:

Additions:
[list]
[*] New Sound effects and VO
[*] New Models & Textures
[*] A short extension to a couple of environments
[*] Added New Game Plus which is unlocked once you finish the game
[*] Additional unlockable bonus upon finishing New Game Plus offering more story/lore
[*] Added a playable mid credits sequence with multiple outcomes showing nods to Inflictions  inspirations
[*] Asynchronous loading of levels means we now have animated loading screens
[*] A new respawn system has been introduced. This means when you die but are remaining in the same level, you will spawn back in where you normally would and some parts of the level will reset. This eliminates load screens which will now only show if the player has made progress to a new level
[*] Added the ability to change antialiasing methods
[*] Added the ability to disable Dynamic Depth of Field as its own option
[*] Added finer controls of interactable elements while using gamepad
[*] Added a new language: Traditional Chinese
[/list]

New Game Plus:
[list]
[*] The ghost is now present in all levels
[*] You will have the camera in all levels
[*] New clues and messages have been added
[*] Many puzzles have been remixed and changed
[*] Some new puzzles are introduced
[*] The ghost spawns faster and moves faster
[*] There are no working lights to combat the ghost
[*] A previously cut/locked section of the hospital level has been re-opened
[*] Crave is a little more active
[*] Additional ending (post credits)
[*] Additional content in bonus level (after completion) 
[/list]

General Changes:
[list]
[*] The credits are now scrolling text in real time rather than a video
[*] Removed the hard difficulty, this is replaced with New Game Plus
[*] Moved language selection from the pause menu to the title screen
[*] With the updating of Unreal Engine, the Depth of Field effects had to be updated to a new method
[*] Increased the maximum mouse/controller sensitivity
[*] Pause menu now uses the right face button (Xbox B Button) to back out when using a controller
[*] Added new prompts to the HUD when examining an object
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed some sound effects using incorrect sound classes which would cause them to play even if that class was muted
[*] Fixed a bug where a photo puzzle involving a key could be manipulated to result in an undesirable outcome
[*] Fixed a few instances of instability that could lead to crashes
[*] Fixed menus to work correctly with controllers
[*] Fixed an instance where the player could crouch through a gap in the collision entering a secret room
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could knock over the bike in the opening level and ride it like a surfboard glitching physics simulation and leave the play space to explore the neighbourhood (Sounds cool right! Well, its gone now)
[*] Multiple controller fixes (too numerous to list, mostly with menu navigation)
[*] Restricted looking angles in the Y axis so you can no longer see the top of your own head
[*] Fixed a bug where setting the shadows to the lowest setting would also disable fog
[*] Fixed a bug where inventory items were not correctly displayed
[*] Fixed a bug where getting all the memories in a specific order could lock you out of the first achievement
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause graphical glitches with some hardware by removing some displacement materials
[*] Fixed instances of missing materials, specifically book covers
[*] Fixed a few typos
[*] Fixed some of the instruction shown on the HUD when examining objects
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could interact with a door keypad from the wrong side of the door
[*] Fixed an issue where loading screen would come up too slowly on slower hardware failing to hide the loaded state of the level
[*] Fixed an instance where the ghost could kill the player through a wall
[*] Fixed a bug where a number was being displayed incorrectly in Japanese
[*] Fixed a bug where audio volume options were not working as intended
[*] Fixed a bug where the TV audio could be heard while the TV was off
[*] Fixed a bug where water effects from the shower would remain on screen
[*] Fixed a bug where fullscreen mode would sometimes run in windowed fullscreen mode
[/list]

Optimisation:
[list]
[*] Refactored code to change the way the player controller interacts with everything. This results in fewer references to direct objects for a small memory gain
[*] Resized some textures in game by hand to eliminate unnecessarily large textures. This frees up to 1GB of memory in some places optimising the game to run and look much better on lower end hardware
[*] Saving files have been streamlined (Your progress and unlocked memories will be brought across from the old save system, options will be reset)
[*] The game now uses level streaming which cuts down on load times significantly on older machines
[*] Suspended cloth simulation on assets that are not currently being rendered for a significant CPU performance increase from a particular part of the game onwards
[*] Optimised AI for a minor CPU performance increase
[*] Optimised sounds to use less memory
[*] Optimised some screen effects to make the game more stable
[*] Increased framerate in particular levels through optimisation of code
[/list]

Store page:
[list]
[*] Added traditional Chinese store page
[*] Updated store page description to reflect new content
[*] Updated all branding of Infliction to Infliction: Extended Cut
[*] Added a new trailer to Steam page
[*] Added new screenshots to Steam page
[/list]

Thank you so much for your continued support. As always there will be a bug thread dedicated to this update in case you find anything I should look at. Have a blast playing the new and improved Infliction: Extended Cut and I hope you enjoy the update.

-Clinton ːInfliction_Grimaceː

notes.title: Infliction Update 2.6.2
notes.content:
Hi all,
Just a quick hotfix to resolve a couple of minor bugs introduced by 2.6.
2.6.2 includes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the title menu would not show up if it couldn’t find a particular save game file
[*] Fixed a few lighting anomalies where some meshes would look incorrectly lit
[*] Rebuilt static lighting across all levels

notes.title: Infliction Update 2.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30271994/40c5f1154b8e7b6ba2de4b8804220ef64f7d6a55.png[/img]
I’m happy to announce Infliction update 2.6. This update focuses on Optimization and bug fixes for some hard to find and significant bugs that have been “haunting” the game for some time. I’m also very excited for one of the new features that I always wanted to add but couldn’t find the time. 
Without further ado, Infliction update 2.6 contains:

Additions:
[list]
[*] Added functionality to lamps. This means the AI will interact with lamps just like it does with regular lights
[*] Updated lamps with IES lighting profiles for added realism
[/list]
Bugs:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where spam clicking on a particular door would cause the player to get  stuck
[*] Fixed an issue where spam clicking on TVs could cause the audio to play while the TV is off
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could re-engage the keypad near the start of the game totally bypassing that segment of the game
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could become stuck in the police station
[*] Fixed a collision bug where if the player crouched and tested the boundaries in the kitchen they could find a secret room through a wall
[*] Fixed an issue where two instances of the ghost could exist at once in the cabin
[*] Fixed an issue with Crave’s AI where you could rush him and he’d get stuck in an animation loop without attacking the player
[*] Fixed a bug where you could trigger the lift and glitch outside of the lift having it leave without you 
[*] Fixed an instance where the reticle could be removed from the screen
[*] Fixed an instance where you could button mash some objects and cause it’s animation to play twice
[*] Fixed a translation error where French subtitle states where reversed
[*] Fixed an issue that was preventing some options to save correctly
[/list]
Optimization:
[list]
[*] Suspended cloth simulation on assets that are not currently being rendered for a significant CPU performance increase from a particular part of the game onward
[*] Optimized AI for a minor CPU performance increase
[/list]
Changes:
[list]
[*] Changed Caustic Reality logo in splash screen
[*] Opening warning and logos will only play when first starting up the game
[*] Tweaked the safe tumbler to be more forgiving
[*] Added some holiday cheer 
[/list]

Happy holidays and thank you so much for your continued support. I’m working on a major content update so keep an eye out for that. Thanks everyone. Have a safe holiday season and I hope you enjoy the update.

-Clinton

notes.title: Infliction Update 2.3 – Russian, French & Japanese
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30271994/240e6b5e7d7352fec02346607607340da1ba97f7.png[/img]

I’m happy to announce Infliction update 2.3. This update adds Russian, French and Japanese subtitles and UI as well as some small additions, changes, improvements and fixes based on community feedback. Apologies for the slight delay of this update, it turned out to be larger than I expected.
Without further ado, Infliction update 2.3 contains:

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Russian language subtitles and UI
[*] Added French language subtitles and UI
[*] Added Japanese language subtitles and UI
[*] Added medium option to Post Processing option in menu. This option disables dynamic depth of field
[*] Added confirmation prompt for starting a new game and overwrite old game
[*] Added a level select screen to the continue option from the main menu. This will only show up once the player has finished the game. It allows the player to continue from any area of the game while retaining collectable progress. Note: If you have a save where you have finished the game, you will need to complete the last level again to trigger this option. Triggered on credits rolling
[*] Added gamepad rumble to some impacts and kills
[*] Made a few objects interactable that weren’t before
[*] Added a new clue to a difficult part of the game
[*] Added new sound effects including UI sounds
[*] Wind now affects the trees in the woods
[*] Added two new ‘scare’ moments that can occur at random
[*] Added some rogue shadows
[*] Four profile images added to Steam
[*] Made accommodations in UI for the addition of more languages
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the phone would ring to offer a clue but would play another audio file instead of the clue
[*] Fixed an issue in the menus where buttons highlight incorrectly
[*] Fixed an issue where gamepad selection in menus didn’t show until selection took place
[*] Fixed an issue where clipping would occur when crouching in front of a vent
[*] Fixed a bug where hugging a wall and hiding under a table could cause the player to clip through that wall
[*] Fixed a bug where instructions would not show correctly when reading books
[*] Fixed a bug where sliding a box would trigger an unintended event
[*] Fixed instances where decal textures were stretching over geometry causing an ugly stretch effect
[*] Fixed an instance where an ambient sound would suddenly cut off
[*] Fixed a few instances where crouching could cause clipping with some objects due to the size of their collision box
[*] Fixed an issue where on occasion, loading screen text wouldn’t show until the load was finished
[*] Fixed an instance where objective text wouldn’t display correctly after death in one particular part of the game
[*] Fixed instances where examined object was too close to the camera
[*] Fixed instances where the flashlight was too weak when examining some objects
[*] Fixed an issue where tutorial text would overlap with subtitle text in very specific instances
[*] Fixed an instance where incorrect subtitles were shown
[*] Fixed a few minor lighting discrepancies where meshes were incorrectly lit
[*] Fixed an issue where picking up a flashlight during a sequence could cause the game to become stuck
[*] Fixed a clipping issue with shower curtains being affected by wind
[*] Fixed a bug where you could un-pause the game while watching a tutorial causing the pause menu to close while the tutorial screen stayed open
[/list]

[b]Optimisation[/b]
[list]
[*] Limited the number of active lights in some levels for a small performance gain
[*] Removed some assets from memory when they’re no longer going to be used in some areas of the game resulting in a minor performance increase
[*] Lowest post processing option (medium) now disables dynamic depth of field. This option can see a performance gain on older PCs in certain areas of the game
[*] Lowest post processing option (medium) now disables effects in scenes with heavy post processing. This results in better performance on older PCs in certain areas of the game

[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced font size on text overlay/plain text as some text would get cut off if the string was too long

[*] Updated discrepancies with a couple of in game documents
[*] Updated end credits
[*] Cleaned up gamepad UI button images
[*] Radios will not begin their broadcast until the player is within earshot
[/list]

Thank you so much for your continued support. I will add more languages over time so keep an eye out in future. Thanks everyone and I hope you enjoy the update.

Cheers,
Clinton.

*Edit* Hot-fix 2.3.1 addresses a glitch introduced in 2.3 where checkpoints were not saving. This has been patched out. Sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Infliction update 2.2
notes.content:
Hi everyone. Update 2.2 is here with some bug fixes, tweaks and changes. A big thank you to those who posted in the bug report thread and brought some of these issues to my attention. The game is better because of your feedback.

More languages are on the way, they’re currently being translated as we speak. I was going to hold this update back until the new languages were ready but I wanted to get these fixes out there now. 

Infliction update 2.2 contains:

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where crouching and then un-crouching while examining an object or taking a photo could cause the interaction system to bug out making doors and other objects no longer respond to input
[*] Fixed a bug that forced the player to stand if crouched after an object interaction takes place
[*] Fixed an instance where the player can get stuck on the trap door
[*] Fixed Teledex and books showing double prompts when using game pad
[*] Fixed an issue causing subtitles to remain on screen
[*] Fixed instances where the inventory was not displaying correctly
[*] Fixed a bug that would allow the player to press a button on the game pad during the warning screen to launch the game without being able to see the menu
[*] Fixed a few instances of mesh/asset clipping with the environment
[*] Fixed an issue were AI pathfinding was inaccurate in one part of the house
[*] Fixed an issue where ducking under a wolfs head and standing would cause clipping
[/list]

[b]Optimization[/b]
[list]
[*] Very minor optimisation improvements
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed subtitles allowing them to show immediately when within range rather than at the start of a new sentence
[*] Door code will automatically reset when player disengages interaction. This means on each new interaction with the door code, it will be reset and ready to receive a new code
[*] Re-timed gamepad rumble
[*] Re-timed a moment where Crave appears 
[*] On screen prompts will now double check the input device in real time. If the game has detected a gamepad but you’re using a mouse, the system will change prompts to reflect the input device being used
[/list]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Added subtle breath sounds to some heartbeat/scare moments moments
[*] Added gamepad rumble to some impacts and kills
[/list]

Update 2.3 will be coming soon and will add a few more languages, some fixes, additions and optimization. 

Thanks for the positivity and continued support. I’m very happy with the state of the game in this version and I owe that to you, the community. Thank you!

-Clinton

[/list]

[b]Additions and changes:[/b]
[list]

[*] Fixed an instance where prompts would fade in and out rather than staying on screen
[*] Fixed an instance where the player crouched under debris at the start of the game could stand up and cause clipping

[*] Fixed an instance where a light switch would turn on the incorrect light

Thanks again for the continued support and positivity. The feedback has been just so helpful and it's really making a difference to the game. Thank you all so much. Happy new year, 2019 is going to be a killer year!

notes.title: Update 1.13 – Optimization update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30271994/ebe98e9749d8fc380577c28102423f61903fcbac.png[/img]

Thank you all for being so patient for this update. Update 1.13 has been mostly focused on optimization – Making improvements to areas where performance issues had been reported by the player community. This update also focuses on fixing reported bugs and implementing a few ‘quality of life’ improvements based on your feedback. Thank you so much!

Without further ado, the Infliction 1.13 update contains the following:

Optimization:
[list]
[*] After waking up from the basement sequence there was a significant performance drop. The culprit was found and could be attributed to overdraw. The result is a 50% performance increase for this area of the game and several other subsequent areas
[*] Areas of the game preceding the above-mentioned area have also seen a 20% performance increase due to improvements to the dynamic lighting optimization system
[*] Volumetric lighting in fog has been tweaked for a small performance gain
[*] Areas of the game that use heavy post processing effects have been optimized for a small performance gain
[*] All lights have had an optimization pass for a small performance gain
[*] Some areas have lights that cannot be switched on or off. These lights have been changed from dynamic to stationary resulting in a small performance gain
[/list]
Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing some lights to not cast light when turned on
[*] Fixed a shader that was causing overdraw and performance issues
[*] Fixed a bug that caused odd collision and behaviour from cloth simulated shower curtain
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could clip with wall sconce lights
[*] Fixed an issue where items of interest would still flash once discovered if the player reloaded their game after discovering something and reloading the same area
[*] Fixed an issue where sometimes, particularly after finding the plane tickets, the players maximum walk speed was extremely slow
[*] Removed the ability to use the camera in some sequences where the player controller is disabled but the camera is not
[*] Fixed an issue that caused a fresh install of the game to use invert Y as the default
[*] Fixed an issue causing hiding under some beds to cause the player to get stuck
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could be killed during a transition (to new areas or to a hiding spot)
[*] Fixed an issue that would prevent the ability to pass through the final doors in the game
[*] Fixed minor clipping issues with sliding boxes
[*] Fixed a few instances where items on top of a box weren’t moving with the box when sliding
[*] Fixed an issue where you could be killed twice only seconds apart causing you to witness your own death again
[*] Fixed the pose of a ‘hiding’ ghost
[*] Minor tweaks to text used for the subtitle system
[*] Fixed an issue where lamp light reflection would show while lamp was not casting any light
[*] Fixed an issue causing the ‘collect all memories’ achievement from popping. It now has a secondary check which should circumvent those whom experienced this bug. If you have finished the game and have all the memories but the achievement didn’t pop, simply continue your game and when the whiteout screen fades your achievement should pop
[*] Fixed an issue where screen mode and resolution would sometimes reset themselves for the menu and loading screen
[*] Fixed an issue where crouching in the elevator could cause the player to become stuck
[*] Fixed an issue where the players position would be offset in the elevator
[*] Fixed an issue causing subtitles to become stuck on screen
[*] Fixed a few lighting inconsistencies 
[*] Fixed minor issues with clipping meshes
[/list]
Updates and changes:
[list]
[*] Moved the counselling pamphlet memory item to a new position that makes sense given the order in which they’re listed
[/list]
Additions:
[list]
[*] Added Vsync on/off option to video options
[*] Added the ability to skip the opening cutscene
[*] Added additional sound occlusion to the ghost in instances where you’re not on the same floor. If you’re not on the same floor, the ghost ambience volume is lessened by 75%
[*] Added a new respawn point in ‘Crave’s lair’
[*] Added subtitles to places that were intended to have subtitles but did not
[*] Added new reflections to areas that lacked reflections
[/list]
Other:
[list]
[*] Updated some key art images on steam
[*] Updated achievement text for the ‘Master chef’ achievement to better reflect how the achievement is earned (this can currently only be earned near the start of the game)
[/list]

Thanks to all for being so patient with this update. I’m really happy with the optimization results and performance gains. A huge thanks and shout out to a few very active members of my community that have gone above and beyond when it comes to bug reporting and general feedback. Your input continues to make Infliction better. Thank you!

I’ll be working on a content update next. This will contain lots of additions to content as well as reported bugs and optimization fixes. I can’t wait to show off the new changes. This is going to be exciting! Thanks for joining me on this journey and the evolution of Infliction.

-Clinton

notes.title: Thank you & Update 1.12 is live!
notes.content:
Hi all,

Thank you again so much for your support since Infliction has launched! Your reviews and posts in the forums mean so much to a solo developer like me. :) Please keep them coming!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30271994/cd668e9be9ba8f725961846f61f0c8358fc99741.jpg[/img]

I arrived home from PAX Australia couple of nights ago, and got straight in to this update. I couldn’t wait to jump in and get this patch done - it’s a big one with a lot of improvements! Thank you so much to the community for being both helpful and patient!

Update 1.12 contains the following fixes and enhancements:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that was causing some memories to not be recognised by the memory system
[*] Fixing the above bug also addressed a bug where the find every memory achievement couldn’t be triggered
[*] The player can no longer hide under the bed during the baby monitor sequence causing the game to break
[*] Removed the ability to pick up and examine objects during interrogation room sequence that would cause the player to become stuck
[*] Fixed collision on several objects and walls that would cause the player to get stuck or pass through
[*] Fixed a bug that indicated a swipe key should open a door but it does not
[*] Fixed a bug that caused some candles to not work in the later part of the game
[*] Flashlight no longer needs a double click to turn off at the start of a new area
[*] Fixed a bug where hitting crouch and hitting the interact button at the same time would cause the player to become stuck in the inspection system
[*] Fixed a bug where hitting the hide button and the interaction at the same time could cause the player to be stuck in the inspection system
[*] Fixed a bug where taking a photo and crouching before the photo comes in to view causes the player to get stuck. 
[*] Fixed examine system so that if the item is off screen, the system will reset the object and exit examine mode. This should work for all situations
[*] Added a few missing names to the credits, sorry about that
[*] Removed ability for AI to spawn in an unfair location after well sequence
[*] Fixed typos in achievements
[*] Small incidental graphical fixes across the game (object placement and such)
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could pick up a phantom version of the key in the key/camera puzzle section
[*] Fixed a bug where a new player would get the continue option however clicking that option would restart the game as it’s looking for a save file that doesn’t exist. It now simply starts a new game.
[*] General fixes to interaction with two objects at once
[*] Minor optimisation tweaks
[*] Added feature: wake-up audio recap cutscenes will only play once per area regardless of kill-count. This is reset when a new game is started. You should only see/hear each one once per playthrough
[*] Adjusted: a longer delay on ghost respawn time when using the camera on the ghost
[/list]

Phew, Again, thanks to the community for actively helping Infliction to improve and grow. And thank you for your patience. Being a one-man team, I tend to work a little slower than a, well… team.
 
The next update I’m already working on and it will contain a few more fixes as well as quality of life improvements such as skippable cutscenes, New checkpoint spawn locations, New hiding spots, More video options etc. I’ll also be doing a big optimisation pass on the next update so keep an eye out for that.
 
One more thing:
Upcoming updates will contain fixes to bugs, quality of life improvements, tweaks and optimisation but I also plan to start including new content in some of these updates. They’ll be free updates for everyone that owns Infliction, so keep an eye out! I’ll be keeping the new content a secret to surprise you all, and I’m excited to start working on it soon.

Thanks again, you all rock! If you’d like to support Infliction, please leave a review if you haven't done so already!

-Clinton

notes.title: Update 1.11 and PAX Australia
notes.content:
Hi all,

Thanks so much for all the positivity and support. Its been overwhelming and heart-warming. All the feedback, both positive and constructive is appreciated.

I am packing my bags to head to PAX but before I leave I wanted to push out the updates I’ve made thus far. Update 1.11 contains the following:

•	Invert Y axis will now invert the mouse as well as the gamepad.
•	Examining an object with plain text can no longer leave text on screen if the text button and interact button are pressed at the same time
•	You can no longer activate the plain text by pressing the plain text button while not holding the object.
•	Removed the use of the camera when crawling through vents as it causes clipping issues
•	Several minor graphical/asset tweaks (Their place and position in the world, clipping objects or hovering objects)
•	Removed the use of the camera during the final ritual cutscene
•	Fixed AI: can no longer become stuck upstairs in the hallway riddle area of the game
•	Fixed a bug that was preventing some achievements from going ding!

Things I’m working on for the next update are as follows:
•	Taking action while performing other actions can cause the player to get stuck (EG: Crouch/interact, camera/interact, Hide/interact) etc.
•	General glitches
•	Collision improvements
•	A few typos
•	Further performance optimisation
•	Alter hiding mechanics to be more predictable and useful
•	Skippable cut scenes on the second instance

I really appreciate your patience. Being a one-man team can be a challenge, but you all have been so amazing and patient with me, it’s much appreciated. I have some big updates planned down the road that incorporate both my own ideas as well as player feedback and I’m excited to see how it all comes together. 

As for this week, I’m off to PAX. Wish me luck. If you’re at PAX Australia, please come and say hi. I’ll see you all when I get back.

-Clinton

notes.title: Launch date announced
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30271994/b672dd51c7e5851f7925e362d9b85201fe58036d.png[/img]

The free demo version is still available from Steam if you haven’t enjoyed it yet, get on it!

I can’t wait to share Infliction with you, and the rest of the world soon. Thank you again for your ongoing support.

notes.title: Development Update - Animation Polish
notes.content:
Hi horror fans,

I’m hard at work putting the finishing touches on my debut title Infliction, and I’m excited to have release date news coming soon!

To celebrate, I wanted to take a behind-the-scenes look at some character animations we have been polishing and new screenshots.

Infliction is built using Unreal Engine 4, and my animator uses a 3D software package to produce creepy character movements. I’ve worked hard to add lots of atmosphere through dynamic lighting, detailed environments, haunting sound effects, and frightening interactions between the player and the ghost.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30271994/ed05b9af9c0a9ad5e344a7e2f19bd70e8a75e913.gif[/img]

Here’s part of the animation when it’s first being worked on - placeholder textures, no lighting or environment. It’s important to get the movement right at this stage, so that it ‘works’ even without the context of the rest of the game. My animator spends a lot of time at this stage to get this feeling right.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30271994/eb739648dd844e7c4b9cd7e99872f1b09d4e7018.gif[/img]

Once I’m confident about the animation, we implement it. Now we can check it out with textures, lighting and the environment - and playtest with this animation factored in. Our playtesters have been loving this in-game - when you play Infliction, this may be one of the ways you meet your end!

Here are some other screenshot examples of scenes I have been polishing. There may be some details that others would miss, let me know if you notice anything mysterious. ;)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30271994/44a881d4b288952dce7654102ba8c5fbd1bb94a9.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30271994/fb2729724d21d126f04489d0076bd668b444b920.png[/img]

Thank you for your continued support.
-Clinton

notes.title: Watching let's plays of the demo is making the game better
notes.content:
Hello there Infliction fans!

It’s been amazing to let people play a small sample of the game in the demo, and it’s proven to be super popular on YouTube as well. The most popular YouTube play through has racked up over a million views! Just search for “infliction” on YouTube and you’ll find dozens of videos!

I’ve learned a lot from watching folks play the demo, and I'm tweaking the final game to make it even scarier. I wrote about these lessons in an Imgur post which attracted a bit of attention. It contains a handful of new GIFs that I haven’t shown publicly before, so if you’re hungry for more game info, go check it out. Just search for “infliction” on Imgur and it’s the top result.

To stay on top of the latest Infliction info, remember you can follow me on social media. I’m CausticReality on Twitter, Facebook, and YouTube, and add a “.com” for the official website.

Thanks again for your support!

- Clinton

notes.title: Stay in touch and get the latest news!
notes.content:
Hello all!

There’s a lot happening in the world of Infliction, and it’s not always possible to keep you up to date on everything via these Steam updates.

One of the best ways to get the latest news is to follow me on social media. You can keep an eye on everything happening via Twitter by searching for @CausticReality, and if you’re more of a Facebook fan, search for Caustic Reality there too.

My crowdfunding campaign just hit its halfway point, and there have been some awesome free bonuses unlocked. Check out either of the above social media accounts to get the latest.

The Infliction demo has also been popular with YouTube “Let’s Play” video creators, with the total number of video views now well over 1.5 million! I’ve been blown away by the positive response the demo has received, both here on Steam and on YouTube.

Thanks again for joining me on this journey, with Infliction’s October release as our shared destination. It’s already been an amazing ride, and it’s only going to get better!

- Clinton

notes.title: The demo is live, and there's a freaky new trailer!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, and thanks for your support of this independent game project. Community support and word of mouth are incredibly important for indie projects like this, so thanks so much for your enthusiasm and encouragement.

I have a few things to announce in this update, so let's jump into it!

First up, the demo is live now! This is a stand-alone experience that you can play through in 10-20 minutes to get a first-hand taste of how the finished game will play. It's spoiler-free, too: I made the demo to sample the gameplay, not spoil the story!

Second, I've made a disturbing new trailer. You can see it here on the Steam page, but I've also uploaded it to YouTube: https://bit.ly/InflictionTrailer If you could watch it, give it a thumbs-up, and share it with your horror-loving friends, that would be great.

I've also launched a Kickstarter to help get the game looking amazing for its Halloween release. If you've enjoyed the demo and the trailer, it would be awesome if you could go and back it.

Thanks again for your support! I've worked on this game on my own for two years, so it's great to finally be showing it to the world, even if it's only a demo and a trailer so far. In four months, you'll be able to play the whole thing!

- Clinton

notes.title: Development update
notes.content:
Although I have not yet announced a release date, I did put a tentative date of Q1 2018 on both my web page and the steam page. I was on track to meet this deadline but something major changed in the scope of the game. Late last year I made the decision that I wanted the game to be more substantial with a greater ability to deliver the story and offer a better experience to you. I can assure you I’m working extremely hard to complete the game and can say with confidence that It will be released this year. I’ve been working on Infliction for over 2 years now and I’m looking just as forward to releasing it as you are to playing it.

I’ll be releasing a second trailer and announcing the official release date shortly, so keep your eyes peeled for that. I know waiting really sucks, but I’m confident that you’ll really appreciate the additional content.

If you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to ask.

Thanks so much for your interest in Infliction, it’s you that boosts my motivation each and every day.
Talk soon,
Clinton – Caustic Reality
